The Marion County Board of County Commissioners welcomes you to its regularly scheduled meeting held the first and third Tuesday of each month at 9 a.m. unless otherwise noted. The zoning portion of the meeting is held on the third Tuesday of each month at 2 p.m. and the third Wednesday of each month at 1:30 p.m., unless otherwise noted.
All commission and zoning meetings are open to the public.
Pre-screening will be conducted upon entering the administrative building, located at 601 SE 25th Ave., Ocala, FL 34471.
As a courtesy to others, silence your cell phones and other electronic devices before entering the auditorium. If you need to take a call, please step outside.
PUBLIC COMMENTS
To encourage participation, ensure equal access to all participants and foster mutual respect, please follow these guidelines.
-Regular BCC Meeting
-There are two (2) public comment portions on the agenda, one reserved for comments related to items specifically listed on the agenda, and one for all other comments.
-To be allotted five (5) minutes, you must sign up the Friday prior to the meeting that you wish to speak at. You can sign up online at https://marionfl.org/comment or via phone at 352-438-2300.
-Those who do not submit a request in advance (by 5:00 p.m. the Friday prior) are still welcome to sign up at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting, but will only be allotted two (2) minutes.
-BCC Planning and Zoning Meeting
-Public Comments during the Planning and Zoning portion of the meeting will be limited to two (2) minutes per speaker. You must sign in at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting.
Marion County staff is available throughout each meeting for your convenience.
Anyone requiring accommodations due to a disability or physical impairment should contact Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300 at least two (2) days before a meeting.
Agenda items are posted on Marion County’s website, https://www.marionfl.org, before each board meeting. Click the “Agendas & Videos” link on the homepage to download the agenda packet and back-up documentation.
The Marion County Clerk of Court keeps the official minutes and audio recordings of commission meetings, workshops and public hearings. To request a copy of these materials, contact the Clerk’s Office at 352-671-5622. Marion County streams video for most board meetings, workshops and public hearings (when applicable) live online through the county’s website. These recordings are archived online after meetings, but copies can be requested by Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300.

\viewkind4\uc1\pard\cf1\fs24 Today is to discuss data centers only, there are no applications that have been submitted.\par
Mr. Minter - Senate Bill 484 preserves County's authority for comprehensive planning and land development regulations for both data centers and large load customers. The public utilities must file a tariff by October 1st and is the large load customer, not the general body of ratepayers. DIRECTION TO STAFF: Reach out to the utilities to make sure we get what has been filed for tariffs. \par
\par
Mr. Mike Turner - Loudoun County, Virginia\par
Vice Chair and Ashburn Supervisor-gave overview on his paper for data centers. He reviewed the 15 best practices for Communities: Six factors communities must address when considering data centers: Noise, Power, Water, Emissions, Setback, Appearance\par
Regarding noise, how do you enforce it and how do you penalize if data center is too loud? Discussion was held on installing sensors and fining data centers that do not follow a noise ordinance.\par
\par
Discussion was held on the ordinance approved last week, could a 50 megawatts data center be approved? Should the 50 be changed to 20 megawatts? DIRECTION TO STAFF: bring ordinance back and change 50 to 20 megawatts. \par
\par
Clay Coarsey - St. John's River Water Management District \par
Reviewed the Consumptive Use Permitting Program \par
\par
Ken Weyrauch - reviewed the comprehensive plan and the land development code plan. He also reviewed SUPs, PUDs and overlay areas to see what would be best suited for a data center applications. Discussion on increasing the noise ordinance and tax structure in the plan would have to be done as well. \par
\par
Michelle Morrison - East Central Florida Regional Planning Council \par
Reviewed potential growth from data centers and local control. She reviewed the surrounding counties stand on data centers. Lake County - 90 day suspension, Brevard County - ineligible, Volusia County-ban, Orange County - looking to draft code with 4 sections of different sizes of data centers, Osceola County - drafting data center ordinance, Seminole County - looking at moratorium, Sumter County - conducting at site suitability and utility capacity analysis. This will drive their code updates and reviewing areas where reclaimed water capacity is available. \par
\par
Chuck - reviewed an initial checklist based on Mr. Turner's 15 best practices. Add community benefit agreement and how that works, implement and start talking internally. How does the County enforce the noise, etc to protect our citizens/County. DIRECTION TO STAFF: anything is going to have to come through this board leave moratorium where it is. staff will come up with plan, take it to LDRC and then the board with a workshop. There will be three public workshops before wording is added permanently into the code. Commissioner Stone asked to make sure the other water management district is following the same guidelines and that they have a public hearing. Chuck stated they do and is part of SB 484. DIRECTION TO STAFF: Coordinate with our County Administrator to bring on staff from Loudoun County as a consultant through an MOU to help with writing the ordinances. Commissioners Curry and Bryant would like to have additional conversations with staff on the moratorium requirements regarding the megawatts being reduced from 50 to 20 or 25.\par
\par
Commissioner Zalak thanked the public for attending and all the experts that attended today. The meeting adjourned at 4:10 p.m.\par

The Marion County Board of County Commissioners welcomes you to its regularly scheduled meeting held the first and third Tuesday of each month at 9 a.m. unless otherwise noted. The zoning portion of the meeting is held on the third Tuesday of each month at 2 p.m. and the third Wednesday of each month at 1:30 p.m., unless otherwise noted.
All commission and zoning meetings are open to the public.
Pre-screening will be conducted upon entering the administrative building, located at 601 SE 25th Ave., Ocala, FL 34471.
As a courtesy to others, silence your cell phones and other electronic devices before entering the auditorium. If you need to take a call, please step outside.
PUBLIC COMMENTS
To encourage participation, ensure equal access to all participants and foster mutual respect, please follow these guidelines.
-Regular BCC Meeting
-There are two (2) public comment portions on the agenda, one reserved for comments related to items specifically listed on the agenda, and one for all other comments.
-To be allotted five (5) minutes, you must sign up the Friday prior to the meeting that you wish to speak at. You can sign up online at https://marionfl.org/comment or via phone at 352-438-2300.
-Those who do not submit a request in advance (by 5:00 p.m. the Friday prior) are still welcome to sign up at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting, but will only be allotted two (2) minutes.
-BCC Planning and Zoning Meeting
-Public Comments during the Planning and Zoning portion of the meeting will be limited to two (2) minutes per speaker. You must sign in at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting.
Marion County staff is available throughout each meeting for your convenience.
Anyone requiring accommodations due to a disability or physical impairment should contact Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300 at least two (2) days before a meeting.
Agenda items are posted on Marion County’s website, https://www.marionfl.org, before each board meeting. Click the “Agendas & Videos” link on the homepage to download the agenda packet and back-up documentation.
The Marion County Clerk of Court keeps the official minutes and audio recordings of commission meetings, workshops and public hearings. To request a copy of these materials, contact the Clerk’s Office at 352-671-5622. Marion County streams video for most board meetings, workshops and public hearings (when applicable) live online through the county’s website. These recordings are archived online after meetings, but copies can be requested by Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300.

title: CLOSING COMMENTS

The Marion County Board of County Commissioners welcomes you to its regularly scheduled meeting held the first and third Tuesday of each month at 9 a.m. unless otherwise noted. The zoning portion of the meeting is held on the third Tuesday of each month at 2:00 p.m. and the third Wednesday of each month at 1:30 p.m., unless otherwise noted.
All commission and zoning meetings are open to the public.
Pre-screening will be conducted upon entering the administrative building, located at 601 SE 25th Ave., Ocala, FL 34471.
As a courtesy to others, silence your cell phones and other electronic devices before entering the auditorium. If you need to take a call, please step outside.
PUBLIC COMMENTS
To encourage participation, ensure equal access to all participants and foster mutual respect, please follow these guidelines.
-Regular BCC Meeting
-There are two (2) public comment portions on the agenda, one reserved for comments related to items specifically listed on the agenda, and one for all other comments.
-To be allotted five (5) minutes, you must sign up the Friday prior to the meeting that you wish to speak at. You can sign up online at https://marionfl.org/comment or via phone at 352-438-2300.
-Those who do not submit a request in advance (by 5:00 p.m. the Friday prior) are still welcome to sign up at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting, but will only be allotted two (2) minutes.
-BCC Planning and Zoning Meeting
-Public Comments during the Planning and Zoning portion of the meeting will be limited to two (2) minutes per speaker. You must sign in at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting.
Marion County staff is available throughout each meeting for your convenience.
Anyone requiring accommodations due to a disability or physical impairment should contact Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300 at least two (2) days before a meeting.
Agenda items are posted on Marion County’s website, https://www.marionfl.org, before each board meeting. Click the “Agendas & Videos” link on the homepage to download the agenda packet and back-up documentation.
The Marion County Clerk of Court keeps the official minutes and audio recordings of commission meetings, workshops and public hearings. To request a copy of these materials, contact the Clerk’s Office at 352-671-5622. Marion County streams video for most board meetings, workshops and public hearings (when applicable) live online through the county’s website. These recordings are archived online after meetings, but copies can be requested by Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300.

title:
The Marion County Board of County Commissioners welcomes you to its Planning and Zoning meeting. All commission and zoning meetings are open to the public.
Pre-screening will be conducted upon entering the administrative building, located at 601 SE 25th Ave., Ocala, FL 34471.
As a courtesy to others, silence your cell phones and other electronic devices before entering the auditorium. If you need to take a call, please step outside.
PUBLIC COMMENTS
To encourage participation, ensure equal access to all participants and foster mutual respect, please follow these guidelines.
-BCC Planning and Zoning Meeting
-Public Comments during the Planning and Zoning portion of the meeting will be limited to two (2) minutes per speaker. You must sign in at the desk located in the foyer of the commission auditorium on the day of the meeting.
Marion County staff is available throughout each meeting for your convenience.
Anyone requiring accommodations due to a disability or physical impairment should contact Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300 at least two (2) days before a meeting.
Agenda items are posted on Marion County’s website, https://www.marionfl.org, before each board meeting. Click the “Agendas & Videos” link on the homepage to download the agenda packet and back-up documentation.
The Marion County Clerk of Court keeps the official minutes and audio recordings of commission meetings, workshops and public hearings. To request a copy of these materials, contact the Clerk’s Office at 352-671-5622. Marion County streams video for most board meetings, workshops and public hearings (when applicable) live online through the county’s website. These recordings are archived online after meetings, but DVDs can be requested by contacting Marion County Administration at 352-438-2300.
